1) Choose the sealed pairing offer from OneDrive EscapeHatchPrivateSync.
2) On your computer, open the pairing code EscapeHatch showed (Notepad).
3) Type that 16-character code here and confirm.
EscapeHatch never pairs silently and never uploads your answers in plaintext.

3) Tap Save proof to OneDrive and store escapehatch-phone-sync-proof.json in that same folder.
Answers stay sealed—only counts and digests are shown.
